title: Release autosync 0.2.0
description:
Prepare for release:

* [x] `git pull`
* [x] Check [current CRAN check results](https://cran.rstudio.org/web/checks/check_results_autosync.html)
* [x] [Polish NEWS](https://style.tidyverse.org/news.html#news-release)
* [x] `urlchecker::url_check()`
* [x] `devtools::check(remote = TRUE, manual = TRUE)`
* [ ] `devtools::check_win_devel()`
* [x] Update `cran-comments.md`
* [x] `git push`
* [ ] Draft blog post

Submit to CRAN:

* [x] `usethis::use_version('minor')`
* [x] `devtools::submit_cran()`
* [x] Approve email

Wait for CRAN...

* [x] Accepted :tada:
* [ ] Finish & publish blog post
* [ ] Add link to blog post in pkgdown news menu
* [x] `usethis::use_github_release()`
* [x] `usethis::use_dev_version(push = TRUE)`
* [ ] Share on social media
* [ ] Slack link to blog post, bluesky, and linkedin in #open-source-comms
